info.title: Lenny Gateway API
info.description: Lenny session, blob, and admin endpoints. See spec/15_external-api-surface.md.

Error.description: §15.1 line 972 / §15.2.1 line 1376 REST↔MCP error envelope. Every gateway error response carries this shape verbatim; SDK generators must surface category and retryable so callers can distinguish a transient network blip from a permanent validation failure.

code.description: §15.1 canonical error code (e.g. VALIDATION_ERROR, UNAUTHORIZED, MCP_PROTOCOL_VERSION_RETIRED).

category.description: §15.1 line 972 — coarse classification used by SDK retry logic.

retryable.description: §15.1 line 972 — true when the client should retry, with backoff bounded by suggestedRetryAfter when present.

details.description: Optional structured per-error context (fields, runbook, suggestedRetryAfter, …).

AdapterCapabilities.description: Routing and protocol capabilities of the adapter serving a runtime-discovery request.

AgentInterface.description: The §5.1 agentInterface descriptor declared on a type:agent runtime.

PublishedMetadataEntry.description: A §5.1 publishedMetadata entry: a named, opaque metadata value with a content type and a visibility class.

PublishedMetadataRef.description: The discovery-surface view of a publishedMetadata entry: key, content type, and visibility without the content.

state.description: §15.1 session state. `resuming` is an internal transient that the GET /v1/sessions/{id} envelope normalises to `resume_pending` → `running`; it appears only on the §10.4 coordinator-handoff `status_change` SSE frame and is included in the enum for SSE wire compatibility.

metadata.description: §7.1 line 6 client-supplied CreateSession metadata, a flat string→string map echoed verbatim across the session lifetime.
§7.1 line 6 client annotations preserved verbatim for the session lifetime. Must be a flat string→string map; non-string values reject with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.

RetryPolicy.description: §7.3 client-supplied retry policy. The gateway clamps each populated field against the deployer caps at admission; a missing/zero value falls through to the cap as the effective value. Negative values reject with 400 VALIDATION_ERROR.

mode.description: §7.3 line 382 retry mode. Defaults to auto_then_client.

retryableFailures.description: §7.3 line 384 retryable failure class advisory list.

nonRetryableFailures.description: §7.3 line 385 non-retryable failure class advisory list.

maxSessionAgeSeconds.description: §7.3 line 389 per-session total-lifetime cap, clamped against the deployer cap.

maxResumeWindowSeconds.description: §7.3 line 390 resume-window timer, clamped against the deployer cap.

conversationContinuity.description: §7.1 — `platform` for session mode (the platform preserves conversation context across messages for the session's lifetime); `none` for service mode (each message routes to any ready replica and clients re-inject context).

contentHash.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 of the streamed bytes (§4.5 line 311)

isArchive.description: True when the body was uploaded via /upload-archive; consumed by the §7.4 extraction pipeline.

UploadToSessionRequest.description: §7.4 mid-session upload payload: the files to overlay onto a running session's /workspace/current.

path.description: Workspace-relative destination; absolute paths and `..` traversal are rejected.

status.description: "filesUpdated" once the overlay is promoted and the runtime is signaled.

files.description: Number of files promoted into the workspace.

sessionPolicy.description: §5.2 session-mode pod-reuse, concurrency, and workspace-cleanup policy. The former task and concurrent modes are presets of this block: recycle.enabled is sequential pod reuse and maxConcurrentSessions > 1 is the concurrent-slot configuration.

maxConcurrentSessions.description: §5.2 simultaneous-session bound per pod. > 1 requires acknowledgeProcessLevelIsolation.

acknowledgeProcessLevelIsolation.description: §5.2 deployer acknowledgment of shared process namespace, /tmp, cgroup memory, network stack, and credential group-read across concurrent slots. Required when maxConcurrentSessions > 1.

recycle.description: §5.2 sequential pod-reuse and whole-pod scrub policy.

acknowledgeBestEffortScrub.description: §5.2 acknowledgment that the workspace scrub is best-effort. Required when enabled.

allowCrossTenantReuse.description: §5.2 cross-tenant sequential reuse. Only valid with isolationProfile: microvm and maxConcurrentSessions: 1.

scrubProfile.description: §5.2 cross-tenant scrub variant for microvm pods.

acknowledgeMicrovmResidualState.description: §5.2 acknowledgment of guest-kernel residual state. Required when scrubProfile: in-place.

onScrubFailure.description: §5.2 disposition when the whole-pod scrub fails.

maxSessionsPerPod.description: §5.2 per-pod served-session retirement bound. Required when enabled.

cleanupCommands.description: §5.2 deployer cleanup executed before the whole-pod scrub.

maxClientIdleSeconds.description: §5.2 / §6.2 client-inactivity bound; defaults to the effective maxSessionAgeSeconds.

OutputPart.description: §15.4.1 content part. `type` is an open string; `inline` and `ref` are mutually exclusive per the resolution protocol.

MessageContent.description: §15.4 MessageEnvelope.input union: a bare string (sugar for a single text OutputPart) or a §15.4.1 OutputPart[] array. The identical union is accepted by the MCP lenny/send_message message argument under the §15.2.1 REST/MCP parity rule.

oneOf.description: §15.4 bare-string shorthand: sugar for a single text OutputPart.

delivery.description: §15.4 line 1715 closed delivery enum. Absent defaults to queued.

MessageRequest.description: §15.1 POST /v1/sessions/{id}/messages body: a §7.2 batch of MessageEnvelope payloads.

post.description: Streams the body into the gateway's Upload Handler subsystem. v1 stores the bytes as a blob; the §7.4 archive extraction pipeline applies the §13.4 ceilings and the zip-slip guard before promoting the extracted tree.

post.summary: Upload files into a running session's workspace (mid-session upload)
post.description: The §7.4 mid-session upload surface. Admitted only when the bound runtime declares capabilities.midSessionUpload and the deployer policy permits it; uses the caller's session-scoped bearer credential (no uploadToken). The gateway streams the files into the pod's /workspace/staging and overlays them onto /workspace/current, signaling the runtime once promotion completes so the agent never sees partially-written files.

200.description: Files promoted and the runtime signaled

400.description: VALIDATION_ERROR — empty file set, bad base64, or path traversal

409.description: INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION (runtime/policy does not permit mid-session upload) or TARGET_NOT_READY (no live pod binding)

502.description: UPSTREAM_ERROR — the pod failed to stage or materialize the upload
